whyStudy.shortAnswer: Turkiyada o'qish — 150 dan ortiq universitetdan YÖK akkreditatsiyalangan diplom, davlat universitetlarida yiliga taxminan 600 AQSH dollaridan boshlanadigan to'lov va 100% gacha stipendiyalar degani. Yuzlab dasturlar ingliz tilida o'tiladi, yashash xarajatlari past, Istanbul, Ankara va Izmir esa mintaqadagi eng kuchli muhandislik, tibbiyot va biznes maktablariga mezbonlik qiladi.

About.v3Body: O‘nlab davlatlardan talabalarda o‘z tillarida qo‘llab-қuvvatlaymiz.

Geo.universityShortAnswer: {name} is a {type} university in {city}, Turkey, founded in {year}. It offers programs in {languages} with tuition starting from {tuition}/year. Accredited by {accreditation}, it hosts over {students} students.
Geo.programShortAnswer: Study {category} in {city}, Turkey. Compare universities, tuition fees, and program details — all in one place. Programs available in English and Turkish with scholarships.
Geo.countryShortAnswer: Students from {country} can study in Turkey with a student visa, affordable tuition from $1,500/year, and programs in English. Free application support and visa guidance included.
Geo.cons1: Turkish language useful for daily life
Geo.step1Text: Browse accredited universities and select a program that fits your goals and budget.
Geo.step2Text: Fill out the free application form. Our consultants review it and guide you on required documents.
Geo.step3Text: Receive your acceptance letter and pay the enrollment deposit to secure your place.
Geo.step4Text: Apply for a Turkish student visa at your local consulate with your acceptance letter.
Geo.step5Text: Arrive in Turkey, convert your visa to a residence permit within 30 days, and start your studies.
Geo.visaStep1Text: Once accepted, your university issues an official acceptance letter required for the visa application.
Geo.visaStep2Text: Submit your visa application at the nearest Turkish consulate with your acceptance letter, passport, and financial proof.
Geo.visaStep3Text: Enter Turkey with your student visa. Book your flight and arrange initial accommodation.
Geo.visaStep4Text: Within 30 days of arrival, apply for a student residence permit at the local immigration office.
Geo.visaStep5Text: Complete university registration, get your student ID, and begin your studies.

Privacy.metaDescription: How StudyHub collects, uses and protects your personal data when you apply to study in Turkey — including cookies and your privacy rights.
Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.s1Body: StudyHub ("we", "us") is a study-in-Turkey consultancy that connects international students with accredited Turkish universities. We operate this website and process your personal data as the data controller.
Privacy.s2Body: When you browse, we collect technical data such as your IP address, browser and pages visited. When you submit an application or contact form, we collect the details you provide: name, email, phone, country, program of interest and uploaded documents such as your passport and diploma.
Privacy.s3Body: We use your data to process and manage your university applications, contact you about your application, send you relevant university offers and scholarships, and improve our website. We never sell your personal data.
Privacy.s4Body: Our website uses essential cookies for functionality and optional analytics cookies to understand how visitors use the site. You can control or delete cookies through your browser settings at any time.
Privacy.s5Body: We share your application data only with the universities you apply to and with trusted partners who help us deliver our service. They are bound by confidentiality and may only use your data for your application.
Privacy.s6Body: Depending on your country, you may have the right to access, correct, delete or export your personal data, and to object to or restrict processing. To exercise any of these rights, contact us — we respond within 30 days.
Privacy.s7Body: We keep your data only as long as needed for your application and legal obligations, and we use industry-standard safeguards such as encryption and access controls to protect it.
Privacy.contact: Questions about your data? Contact us at {email} or via our contact page.

Terms.metaTitle: Terms of Service — Study in Turkey
Terms.metaDescription: The terms that govern your use of the StudyHub website and our free study-in-Turkey application and consultation services.
Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.s1Body: StudyHub provides free guidance and application support for international students applying to accredited universities in Turkey. Our consultants help you choose programs, prepare documents and manage your applications.
Terms.s2Body: You confirm that the information and documents you provide are accurate and genuine. False documents or information may lead to cancellation of your application and could affect your university admission.
Terms.s3Body: University admission decisions are made solely by the universities. While we work to give you the best chance, we cannot guarantee acceptance, scholarship awards or specific outcomes.
Terms.s4Body: Our consultation and application support services are free. Tuition fees and any university or government charges are paid directly to the relevant institutions and are not collected by us.
Terms.s5Body: We provide our website and services on an "as is" basis. To the maximum extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect or consequential losses arising from your use of the site or our services.
Terms.s6Body: We may update these terms from time to time. The latest version is always available on this page, and continued use of the site after changes means you accept the updated terms.
Terms.s7Body: If you have questions about these terms, contact us at {email} or through our contact page.
